title: You Sit Completely Still, Yet Watching Someone Grab Food Fires Your Motor Cortex
description:
You flinch when a stranger stubs a toe, yet your body stayed still! Yet one lab snack proved movement cells fire just by watching! This is the true story of Giacomo Rizzolatti's Mirror Neuron Discovery. Here is what went wrong with brain maps in nineteen ninety-two.
